DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_Remote_1: Hatchling! Hornfels wants to talk to you about something they found.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_Remote_2: They sounded pretty excited, you should probably get up there quick!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_Remote_List1_Choice1_1: Alright, let me know if it's just all that telescope time getting to their head!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_Remote_List1_Choice2_1: Hey! What did I do to you?
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_List1_Choice1: What did you want from me again?
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_List1_Choice1_1: Hornfels wants to talk to you, something about a distant supernova or something like that? Whatever it was, they seemed pretty excited.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_List1_Choice1_2: Best check on them sooner rather than later. All the time they spend looking through that telescope, I wouldn't be surprised if it's finally getting to their head.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_List1_Choice2: I met with Hornfels, they showed me a new system with an incredibly massive black hole.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_List1_Choice2_1: Yeah, Hornfels had their eye on that star because they were eager to see it go supernova.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_List1_Choice2_2: A black hole more massive than previously thought possible...I'm sure Hornfels is blown away.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_List1_Choice3: I made it to a new star system!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_List1_Choice3_1: Stars above, you have? How on Hearth did you manage to do it?
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Slate_Intro_List1_Choice3_2: Best of luck on your travels!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_Default_1: Glad you could made it, Hatchling! I figured since you were taking your first flight today, I could show you this newly-discovered anomaly!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_Default_2: A massive star at the core of our galaxy has gone supernova, and collapsed into the most powerful black hole us Hearthians have ever seen.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_Default_3: Go on, take a look! You might even catch a signal on your Signalscope!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_Telescope_1: That black hole's quite a spectacle, isn't it? If only we could study it up close.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_Telescope_2: Looks like the telescope's picking up some sort of signal too. You might be able to scan it with your signalscope.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_Telescope_3: Heh, don't worry hatchling, I'll make sure to keep a close eye on the black hole. There's plenty of phenomena a whole lot closer than it for you to explore!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List1_Choice1: The frequency from the telescope led me to Hollow's Lantern.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List1_Choice1_1: Hollow's Lantern? I didn't even think there was anything on that molten rock!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List1_Choice1_2: Nah, it doesn't matter all that much. We'll take any new information we can find, right?
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List2_Choice1: It told me that Black Hole Warp Cores break out and expand when exposed to heat, causing the weilder to warp
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List2_Choice1_1: Extreme heat causes the Warp Core to shatter and the Black Hole inside to swell in size?
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List2_Choice1_2: Wow, that sounds very interesting! I wouldn't suggest trying it yourself though.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List2_Choice1_3: You only live once after all, best not to throw that away testing millenia-old theories!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List1_Choice2: I was able to make it to the Black Hole's system!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List3_Choice1: Nope. I used a heat-exposed Nomai Warp Core to get there.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List3_Choice1_1: Of course! Extreme heat causes the Black Hole Warp Core to expand and warps all in its path. It all makes sense!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List3_Choice1_2: You are one lucky Hearthian! I wish I could go with you.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List4_Choice1: Hmmm.... Probably not the best idea.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List4_Choice1_1: How so? Is the black hole too dangerous?
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List5_Choice1: Because the universe is d- Nevermind.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List5_Choice1_1: The universe is dangerous? Indeed it is. Maybe it's better I admire it from afar.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_Hornfels_Intro_List5_Choice1_2: I'd like to know more about what you find! Safe travels!
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_NOM_Anomaly_1: POKE: Annona- there has been something eating away at my mind since we started working with these warp cores. Do you think something interesting might happen if the warp core was exposed to extreme heat, such as molten lava?
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_NOM_Anomaly_2: ANNONA: Well... that is certainly not an advisable course of action, but from what we've seen in the process of the warp cores' development, I suspect it would result in a rapid expansion of the singularity contained within.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_NOM_Anomaly_3: POKE: Truly curious! Do you think it would retain its properties of instantaneous transportation, even at this size?
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_NOM_Anomaly_4: ANNONA: I suspect as much, yes, but as the destination is unpredictable, it is, once more, inadvisable.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_NOM_Anomaly_5: POKE: I suppose that is a reasonable assessment. Perhaps one day, when we have the luxury of time to research side projects again, we could look into this phenomenon further.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_NOM_Anomaly_6: ANNONA: An excellent mentality to have, my apprentice, though I suspect some of the other Nomai might be a little more... enthusiastic, to try it out. We must dispose of this recording.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_NOM_Anomaly_7: POKE: I see. I will find a place to dispose of this, then.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_NOM_Anomaly_8: ANNONA: I know how you operate, Poke… please don’t just throw it into the black hole.
DialogueDictionary.$NoD_NOM_Anomaly_10: ANNONA: Thank you. Let us continue with our work, then! We have much to do.
